assess.unsupported-export: Yeh bill export ka hai. Yeh app abhi export bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-export.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao, ya marking galti se lagi ho to hata do.
assess.unsupported-sez: Yeh bill SEZ unit ko hai. Yeh app abhi SEZ bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-sez.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao.
assess.unsupported-deemed-export: Yeh deemed export hai. Yeh app abhi yeh bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-deemed-export.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao.
assess.unsupported-reverse-charge: Is bill par tax customer bharega (reverse charge). Yeh app abhi aisa bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-reverse-charge.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao, ya marking hata do.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt: Yeh advance ki receipt hai. Yeh app abhi advance receipt nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-advance-receipt.do: Draft saved hai. Kaam hone par bill banao, ya CA se receipt banwao.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply: Yeh non-GST cheez hai (jaise petrol). Yeh app abhi aisa bill nahi banata.
assess.unsupported-non-gst-supply.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh ek bill apne CA se banwao.
assess.gst-status-unconfirmed: Bill sahi bane, isliye pehle batao: aap GST mein registered ho ya nahi?
assess.gst-status-unconfirmed.do: Aap mein jaake GST status chuno. Pata na ho to CA ek minute mein bata dega.
assess.composition-tax: Composition mein ho, isliye bill par GST nahi le sakte.
assess.composition-tax.do: Har line ka GST hata do; bill of supply banega.
assess.composition-legend: Bill par likha jayega: "composition taxable person, not eligible to collect tax on supplies".
assess.unregistered-no-gst: Aap GST mein registered nahi ho, isliye is bill par GST nahi lagta.
assess.gst-off-plain-invoice: Aapne is bill par GST nahi lagaya: yeh saada invoice banega.
assess.missing-gstin: GST bill ke liye aapka GSTIN chahiye.
assess.missing-seller-state: Sahi GST ke liye aapki dukaan ka State chahiye.
assess.missing-place-of-supply: Yeh supply kis State ke liye hai, batao.
assess.missing-place-of-supply.do: Bill mein customer ka State chuno.
assess.rate-not-chosen: {n} item par GST rate nahi chuna, toh us par GST nahi lagega.
assess.rate-not-chosen.do: Har item ka rate chuno. Sach mein 0% ho to 0% chuno, taaki bill kahe aapne socha hai.
assess.nil-rated-on-tax-invoice: Har line 0% hai: aisa bill 'bill of supply' hota hai. "GST lagega? Nahi" karo.
assess.self-billing: Customer ka GSTIN aapka hi hai.
assess.hsn-too-short: {n} item ka HSN code chhota hai: kam se kam {digits} digit chahiye.
assess.hsn-too-short.do: Item mein poora HSN/SAC code daalo.
assess.hsn-missing: {n} item par HSN code nahi hai ({digits} digit chahiye). Item mein daal do.
assess.b2c-recipient-details: ₹{amount} ya zyada ke bill par bina-GST customer ka naam, pata aur State chahiye.
assess.b2c-recipient-details.do: Customer mein pata aur State daalo.
assess.e-invoicing-unscreened: Kuch GST wali dukaanon ko sarkari e-invoice portal se bill banana padta hai. Hum yeh check nahi kar paye.
assess.e-invoicing-unscreened.do: Aap mein saal ka turnover daalo, ya CA se poochh ke confirm karo ki e-invoice aap par lagu nahi.
assess.e-invoicing-self-declared: Aapne confirm kiya hai ki e-invoice aap par lagu nahi.
assess.e-invoicing-applicable: Aapke turnover par bill sarkari e-invoice portal se banne chahiye. Yeh app abhi woh nahi karta.
assess.e-invoicing-applicable.do: Draft saved hai. Yeh bills e-invoice provider ya CA se banwao.
assess.irn-window-passed: Bill {days} din se purana hai: ab e-invoice portal par nahi jayega.
assess.irn-window-passed.do: Aaj ki date se bill banao, ya CA se baat karo.
assess.credit-note-unlinked: Credit note kis bill ke liye hai, woh chahiye.
assess.credit-note-unlinked.do: Bill kholke 'Rakam kam karo' se banao.
assess.credit-note-late: {number} ka tax ab kam nahi ho sakta: aakhri tarikh {date} thi.
assess.credit-note-late.do: Bina tax wali credit note ke liye CA se baat karo.

assess.no-rules-for-date.do: 1 July 2017 ke baad ki date chuno.
assess.no-lines.do: Kam se kam ek kaam likho.
